widgets_values: Late Night Trap, 95 BPM, Heavy 808 Bass, Wet Synths, Female Background Vocals, Male Rap Vocals + Seductive Female Vocals, Dark Bedroom Production, Atmospheric Club Vibes, Breathy Whispers, Slap Bass, Deep Sub Bass, Cinematic R&B Soundtrack Feel

[Verse 1]
Open up the canvas, blank slate on my screen
Drag a checkpoint loader, you know what I mean
KSampler in the middle, VAE on the right
Clip text encode, yeah I'm building tonight
[Chorus]
Connect the nodes, run the queue
Watch the latent flow right through
Green dot to green dot, link it up
Positive prompt in my cup
[Verse 2]
Empty latent image, set the width and height
Plug it to the sampler, get the settings right
CFG at seven, steps at twenty-two
Hit that Queue Prompt button, render coming through
[Bridge]
Upscale node, ControlNet in the chain
Lora stacked on Lora driving me insane
Save image at the end of every single flow
Red wire means broken — fix it, let it go
[Outro]
Nodes connected, workflow clean
Best AI pipeline you ever seen
ComfyUI, yeah we building art
One node at a time right from the start
